title_draft: Zad Archery Patch 1.0.2: Guardian, King Achievement and Gem Fixes
quick_answer_draft: Patch 1.0.2 fixes three progression blockers: monster gems now count when farming below your highest level, missed Guardians are restored so the King is no longer permanently locked, and the Defeat the King Steam achievement can unlock correctly after Steam connectivity problems.

claims.text: Monster gems now count when farming a level below the player's highest.
A Guardian that failed to appear could permanently lock the King; missed Guardians are restored on restart.
Defeat the King achievement unlock was fixed for cases where Steam was unreachable.
The player's own screen resolution is now added as the first option in settings.
